paragraph: La patinoire de Somerset House propose désormais des sessions de patinage pour les utilisateurs de fauteuil roulant et des sessions relaxées à capacité réduite, selon Time Out London. Ces sessions sont prévues pour accueillir les personnes à mobilité réduite et offrir une expérience de patinage plus calme et accessible.

sourceContext.excerpt: C-led bass collective BUMPAH and Latinx queer party organisers 2CPERREA . There’ll also be a K-Pop party on November 23 in collaboration with the Korean Cultural Centre, bringing tunes from BTS, BLACKPINK and emerging artists from the region. In the daytime, there will be a Skate School for adults and teens looking to boost their confidence on the ice and a Kids’ Club for children aged six to 12. There’ll also be dedicated sessions for wheelchair users and reduced-capacity relaxed sessions. Once again Shelter will be next to the rink with its boutique pop-up full of sought-after brands like AllSaints and Nobody’s Child, there’ll be food and drink offerings in The Chalet and, after they’re done skating, ticket holders will be able to access the exhibitions being held at Somerset House, too.
